fusions.name: Locked Jaw
fusions.desc: Bites down and holds on, which deals 14 damage, stuns the target for 1.3 seconds and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Porch Howl
fusions.desc: A long, low howl across a cone 4 tiles long that deals 26 resonating damage and leaves everything in it [Weakened] for 8 seconds. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Let It Lie
fusions.desc: For 9 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and leaves them [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hearthside Hound
fusions.desc: A bonded old hound keeps beside you. Every 2.2 seconds it bites an enemy within 4 tiles, which deals 7 damage and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds.
